tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: App background behind panels — the 'desk' of the workspace. ink, ink-muted and ink-subtle all pass 4.5:1 on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, forms, table rows — where work happens. All ink tokens and every status/ai text token pass 4.5:1 here.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table headers, read-only fields, the source-document pane, wells. ink and ink-muted pass; ink-subtle does not (light) — use ink-muted here.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Row hover, selected list item, pressed quiet button.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows, panels and cards. Decorative only — never a control's sole boundary.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and checkbox borders, control outlines. 3:1+ on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, headings, figures. 13:1+ on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, help text, metadata, table headers. 5.7:1+ on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders, timestamps, disabled-ish hints. 4.5:1+ on canvas and surface only.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Field green. Primary buttons, active nav, selected step, links. As text: 6.4:1+ on every surface.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed fill for brand buttons.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill (7.6:1 light, 8:1 dark). Never plain white in dark.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Selected rows, active tab background, completed-step fill. brand text on it 6:1+.

tokens.name: harvest
tokens.usage: Harvest ochre — identity accent. Charts' highlight series, cover, empty-state illustration fills. Never text on light surfaces (fails 4.5:1); fine as a fill with ink on it.

tokens.name: ai
tokens.usage: Dew teal — anything the AI produced or proposes: suggestion borders, sparkle icon, 'Suggested' labels. 5.4:1+ as text on every surface and on ai-tint.

tokens.name: ai-tint
tokens.usage: Background of AI-suggested fields and suggestion cards until a person accepts them.

tokens.name: ai-line
tokens.usage: Dashed border on AI-filled fields awaiting review (paired with the 'Suggested' label, never colour alone).

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Approved, valid, complete. Text 4.9:1+ on surfaces and positive-tint. Always with a check icon or word.

tokens.name: positive-tint
tokens.usage: Approved badge / success banner background.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Needs information, low confidence, threshold near. Text 4.9:1+ on surfaces and caution-tint.

tokens.name: caution-tint
tokens.usage: Caution badge / warning banner background.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Declined, invalid, destructive. Text 4.8:1+ on surfaces and negative-tint. Lighter than positive in dark, darker in light — tellable without hue.

tokens.name: negative-tint
tokens.usage: Error field background, declined badge, error banner.

tokens.name: on-negative
tokens.usage: Text on a negative fill (danger button).

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Referred, informational notes, focus ring. Text 5.6:1+ on surfaces and info-tint.

tokens.name: info-tint
tokens.usage: Info banner and 'Referred' badge background.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. Alias of info.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Workspace landing title. Once per screen, at most.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Card and panel titles, form group titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Yield estimates are based on the last three seasons.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body; selected nav item.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Step numbers, table group headers. Uppercase via CSS.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Amounts, hectares, IDs in tables and fields. Tabular, right-aligned.

styles.name: figure-lg
styles.usage: Headline figure on a decision panel or KPI tile.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; table cell vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input horizontal padding; table cell horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (compact); gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card / panel padding; gap between form groups.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutters; gap between major sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding; top of workspace landing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, checkboxes, chips, table cell focus.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, dialogs, the drop zone.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Step markers, avatars, confidence meters.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Cards resting on canvas. Most surfaces use a line instead.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dialogs, the AI assistant drawer.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact buttons and inputs inside tables.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button and input height.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary decision actions; touch targets on tablets in the field.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Workspace navigation width.

tokens.name: assistant
tokens.usage: AI assistant / source-document side panel width.
